<DOCSTRING>
Manages a list of users and processes them based on their age.

This class is used to create a new UserManager object to store and manage a collection of users. It initializes an empty list to hold the users and processes each user based on whether they are an adult or a minor.
</DOCSTRING>

<DOCSTRING>
users (list): List of User objects managed by this class. Initialized as an empty list during object creation.
</DOCSTRING>
